scope: Deterministic tone polarity metrics over a frozen prediction run
validated_behaviors: Run, dataset, cases, method configuration and predictions are hash-bound.
Five fixed polarity classes remain in macro F1 and support reporting.
Missing predictions and explicit abstentions remain in the denominator.
Unknown recall, coverage, confusion and Wilson accuracy interval are reported.
Language, source-kind and difficult-phenomenon slices include support warnings.
Cross-split cases, stale content, bad confidence and open prediction rows fail closed.
known_boundary: Synthetic fixture scores only test metric mechanics. A real baseline, candidate comparison, calibration and release admission remain separate.
